recognize_zh: 抹片以藍紫色無結構壞死物與空泡為主，只零星散布幾個小而深染、固縮的核殘影（pyknotic nuclei），看不到正常成熟的造血細胞，符合骨髓壞死。
features: Amorphous, smudged basophilic granular material with numerous clear vacuoles
Scattered small, dense, dark pyknotic nuclear remnants without discernible cytoplasm
Absence of recognizable intact myeloid, erythroid or megakaryocytic elements
Fine purple granular/fibrillar debris in the background
Faint pale tan-gray ghost red cell outlines within the debris
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (Wright-Giemsa) shows aggregates of amorphous, smudged basophilic material with multiple clear vacuoles and fine granular debris. Only scattered small, hyperchromatic pyknotic nuclear remnants are seen; intact hematopoietic cells with preserved cytoplasm and chromatin detail are not identified. Pale ghost red cell outlines are present in the background. Findings are consistent with bone marrow necrosis; the trephine biopsy and any viable areas should be examined for an underlying neoplasm or other cause.

ddx.vs: Technical artifacts still preserve intact cells with cytoplasm in thinner areas, whereas necrosis shows only pyknotic remnants in structureless debris.
Serous atrophy shows homogeneous pink-lilac extracellular material with intact (though sparse) cells, not granular debris with pyknotic nuclei.

ddx.dx: Acute leukemia with extensive cell smudging
ddx.vs: Smudged blasts in leukemia leave identifiable nuclear chromatin strands and some intact blasts, whereas necrotic smears lack viable cells.
